title: Panda LLM: Training Data and Evaluation for Open-Sourced Chinese Instruction-Following Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmarks used (LogiQA-v2, C³, C³-Mixed, C³-Dialogue) measure general QA and reasoning capabilities in Chinese.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research.
